recap.text: Carl's first ten boxes float before him single file and open by tier. The third gives him a toad cudgel, the fourth a Poker, a wrought-iron fireplace poker with a screw-on point. When a level-four cockroach, a Scatterer Brood Guardian, charges, the cudgel bounces off its head, and when Carl stabs with the poker, the giant head knocks it out of his hand. He kills the roach with his feet and shoves the poker into his inventory as useless.

beats.headline: Bronze Weapon Box, four of ten
beats.text: Carl's first ten boxes pop out of his inventory and float in front of him single file, opening by tier. The third, a Bronze Weapon Box, gives him a toad cudgel. The fourth is another Bronze Weapon Box, and this one isn't much better: a Poker. It is literally a fireplace poker, a wrought-iron stick with a screw-on point at the end. After it come one more bronze box, then the silver ones and the gold.
beats.gist: Carl's first ten boxes float out single file, and the fourth gives him a fireplace Poker.

beats.headline: Knocked out of his hand
beats.text: A Scatterer Brood Guardian, a level-four cockroach, charges, and the toad cudgel bounces off its head. Carl quickly switches to his poker to see if that's better. It charges again and he stabs with the iron stick; its giant head knocks the poker right out of his hand, and it goes flying. This place has the shittiest weapons. He kills the roach with his feet. Then he retrieves the poker, decides the damn thing is useless, and shoves it into his inventory.
beats.gist: A roach's head knocks Carl's poker away; he kills it with his feet, shoving the poker into inventory.
